# Pretext 0.0.3, vendored

The five files in `dist/` of `@chenglou/pretext@0.0.3` (MIT, licence beside
this file), copied unchanged from
`https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@chenglou/pretext@0.0.3/dist/` on 19 October 2026.

The homepage used to import this from esm.sh. A module `import` cannot carry a
Subresource Integrity hash, so a change on that CDN would have run on the
homepage unchecked. Served from our own origin, it changes only when this folder
does. The package has no dependencies; the files import only each other.

SHA-384 of each file as copied:

- `analysis.js`: `v2yaBPuCsz5Y6/QG98dN4X89atbHMpDy8BbkBUkX0CzZwQfheOQvq+wuGJ4DToqw`
- `bidi.js`: `KNayNROhbieuLj25GspQUJN4eKOTs6XWDaCIZJ8q6D3bvbhpI+ttXsRZ3YQzzc+X`
- `layout.js`: `KUAVcHKYB/iv8muXkXlXdjYmfjJgexkjoWrFXz9eXiLXiCk4/csrQ1VvKw+NzcwM`
- `line-break.js`: `QXM+CdqkToky/awftyGQxF9SqCWHVsh5O8ut+2J3acPj6KDPCroSRpD5kJeJ7IZo`
- `measurement.js`: `dt7hK2qqWM+ctiGV/3wCXp/gr6qdKA2fiJBO9vZCT0Q0UO4DeUVR9csvLeavscKE`

To upgrade, copy the new version's `dist/*.js` into a new folder named for the
version and change the import in `index.html`. 1.0.0 (October 2026) is a major
version and has not been tried here.
